decisions.title: EC01 parse env object boundary
decisions.statement: For env-config-contract-typescript, parse raw process environment into unknown-backed config input before reading feature flags.
decisions.falsifier: A string from process.env reaches RuntimeConfig without parser narrowing.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove every environment variable in external repos is safe.

decisions.title: EC02 mode union
decisions.statement: For env-config-contract-typescript, runtime mode must narrow to development, staging, or production.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove these are the right modes for every product.

decisions.title: EC03 feature flag precedence
decisions.statement: For env-config-contract-typescript, explicit config files override environment defaults before feature flags are exposed.
decisions.falsifier: A default environment flag overrides an explicit config file value.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove every precedence rule in real deployment config.

decisions.title: EC04 secret redaction
decisions.statement: For env-config-contract-typescript, config readback must redact token and secret values.
decisions.falsifier: Config readback prints API_TOKEN or SECRET_KEY values.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove complete secret scanning.

decisions.title: EC05 invalid port proof
decisions.statement: For env-config-contract-typescript, invalid PORT must return invalid_config with a focused test.
decisions.falsifier: PORT=abc becomes NaN or default silently.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove full deployment validation.

decisions.title: EC06 no global mutation
decisions.statement: For env-config-contract-typescript, config tests must pass explicit env maps instead of mutating process.env globally.
decisions.falsifier: Tests depend on ordering because process.env remains mutated.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove all test isolation issues are solved.

decisions.title: EC07 target owner files
decisions.statement: For env-config-contract-typescript, plan from AGENTS, config contract, src/config, and tests only.
decisions.falsifier: Planning uses parent KRN package source as target truth.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove owner-file recall for arbitrary repos.

decisions.title: EC08 surgical config scope
decisions.statement: For env-config-contract-typescript, repair config parsing and tests without rewriting the app framework.
decisions.falsifier: A config repair rewrites routing, build tooling, or unrelated modules.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove future target repairs are always config-only.

decisions.title: EC09 reuse unknown-first TypeScript pattern
decisions.statement: Reuse KRN TypeScript practice: external config input stays unknown until a narrow parser proves shape.
decisions.falsifier: The target-specific repair uses casts instead of narrowing.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove every KRN internal standard transfers unchanged.

decisions.title: EC10 reuse finite result state
decisions.statement: Reuse finite result-state practice for config parsing instead of thrown or null configuration failures.
decisions.falsifier: Config parsing returns RuntimeConfig or null after repair.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove every target API needs discriminated unions.

decisions.title: EC11 reuse focused invalid config tests
decisions.statement: Reuse focused invalid-input tests before claiming a config boundary is repaired.
decisions.falsifier: The repair has only happy-path config tests.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove broad target quality.

decisions.title: EC stale stringly mode
decisions.statement: For env-config-contract-typescript EC02, runtime mode can remain any string.
decisions.falsifier: The current contract narrows mode to development, staging, or production.

decisions.title: EC stale default precedence
decisions.statement: For env-config-contract-typescript EC03, default environment flags can override explicit config files.
decisions.falsifier: The current contract says explicit config files override defaults.

decisions.title: EC rejected print secrets
decisions.statement: For env-config-contract-typescript EC04, print raw secrets in config readback to simplify debugging.

decisions.title: EC rejected mutate global env
decisions.statement: For env-config-contract-typescript EC06, mutate process.env directly in every config test.

decisions.title: EC rejected framework rewrite
decisions.statement: For env-config-contract-typescript EC08, replace the app framework to fix config parsing.
decisions.falsifier: A config repair rewrites unrelated framework surface.
